name: PHIL 5344
title: Seminar in Philosophical Logic
description: Topics in the philosophies of logic and mathematics. May include completeness results for non-classical logics, higher-order languages and logics, diagonalization, limitative theorems (Tarski, Godel), paradoxes, and formal theories of truth. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Open to Philosophy Graduate students only, others with permission of instructor.
